title: Evaluate constrained platform resolution for explicit Codex workspace write grants
outcome: If explicit inside-workspace grants prove necessary, establish their extent without host traversal of untrusted aliases or mounts.
acceptance: Document whether explicit inside-workspace additional grants are needed beyond ordinary native-capped asks, with concrete provider request evidence.

If implemented, use a kernel-constrained no-follow/no-mount boundary on supported platforms and behavioral tests for aliases, reparse points, mount traversal and concurrent replacement; never introduce a following pre-refusal host lookup.
